title: Every qcqs object of the pro-etale site admits a simplicial hypercover over it with each term a single spectrum of a w-contractible ring and with covering proper-face matching arrows.
statement: Let X be any scheme and U a quasi-compact quasi-separated object of X_proet. There exists a simplicial object W in the slice over U such that every W_r has underlying site object literally a spectrum Spec D_r for a w-contractible ring D_r; the augmentation W_0 to U is a singleton pro-etale cover; and for each r there is a limiting cone c of the proper-face diagram in degree r+1 with an arrow mu from W_(r+1) to c.pt, whose underlying arrow is a singleton pro-etale cover and whose composite with each cone projection equals the corresponding simplicial proper-face map. Weak contractibility of representable sheaves is derived separately in the parent theorem.

proof.text: Apply the formal w-contractible hypercover theorem. Realize every finite family by a scheme coproduct using the qcqs finite-family geometry theorem. Its sheaf coproduct mapping property defines the augmentation and all simplicial maps; the coproduct universal property proves the functor laws. The existing affine-hypercover geometry proof supplies the proved sheaf realization finite-limit preservation, finite proper-face categories, comparison of canonical matching arrows, and universe-lowering of representable epimorphisms. Apply those proofs to the formal hypercover to obtain epimorphisms of represented sheaves. Construct actual proper-face limits in the qcqs slice and preserve them under its inclusion, so the targets remain quasi-separated. The representable epi covering criterion turns these epimorphisms into singleton covers, since the terms are finite coproducts of qcqs affines. Identify each finite coproduct with a w-contractible spectrum and apply spectrum replacement, retaining all matching equations and covering assertions.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_single_affine_wContractible_hypercover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt) (hUqc : CompactSpace U.left)
    (hUqs : QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left) :
    ∃ (W : SimplicialObject (Over U)),
      (∀ (r : ℕ),
        ∃ (D : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : Spec D ⟶ X) (hf : WeaklyEtale f),
          IsWContractibleRing D ∧
            (W _⦋r⦌).left = @Scheme.ProEt.mk X _ f hf) ∧
      Presieve.singleton (W _⦋0⦌).hom ∈
        (Scheme.ProEt.precoverage X) U ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ),
        ∃ (c : Cone (SimplicialObject.properFaceDiagram W (r + 1)))
          (μ : W _⦋r + 1⦌ ⟶ c.pt),
          Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧
            Presieve.singleton μ.left ∈ (Scheme.ProEt.precoverage X) c.pt.left ∧
            (∀ (a : SimplicialObject.ProperFaceCategory (r + 1)),
              μ ≫ c.π.app (Opposite.op a) = W.map a.obj.hom.op))
